verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs place the PayPal button directly on the merchant's site. Expanded Checkout adds card fields that can be customized with the business's branding, which covers embedded, customizable payment components. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the components embed or render inline without a redirect, details on the depth of styling and customization options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Accept PayPal payments on your website. Customers can select the PayPal button on your site and pay with any funding source linked to their PayPal account.
Expanded Checkout includes all offerings from PayPal Checkout and card field customization with your business branding.
